claims.text: A 4-month-old boy who could not look up was admitted to find the causes of developmental delay. In the neonatal period he had infectious pneumonia, myocardial damage and hypokalemia that improved with CPAP-assisted ventilation, amoxicillin clavulanate potassium and supportive treatment, and he was discharged. His birth weight was 2.5 kg; the paternal family history showed no abnormality and the maternal history was unknown because the mother was adopted.
